close_reason: Superseded by PKIX-amgn.5 commit c70821b4 + PKIX-amgn.7 commit 27d67955: pkix-lint/README.md intro rewritten to 'framework + RFC-conformance lints' scope, 'Built-in lints' table now lists only rfc5280.* (1 entry) and points users at pkix-lint-cabf for CABF bundles; usage example imports pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br::CabfTlsBrProfile. Crate-level rustdoc cross-references in pkix-lint/src/rfc5280.rs updated. Example version strings in lib.rs/report.rs/oscal/emit.rs doc comments updated 'pkix-lint/cabf_tls_br v0.2.0' → 'pkix-lint-cabf/cabf_tls_br v0.2.0'.
description:
## Why

After PKIX-amgn.5.2 moves `cabf_tls_br` out of `pkix-lint`, the README and rustdoc still market the crate as CA/B Forum-shaped. They need to reframe `pkix-lint` as "framework + RFC-conformance lints" and absorb the CABF content into `pkix-lint-cabf`'s docs.

## What

### `pkix-lint/README.md`

- L3, 10, 42 — replace narrative CA/B Forum references with RFC 5280 framing where the framework intent is meant; remove where they refer specifically to BR rule content.
- L47 — section header `## Built-in lints (`pkix-lint::cabf_tls_br`)` → `## Built-in lints (`pkix-lint::rfc5280`)`. Replace six-lint table with the `Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint` row (and any RFC-conformance lints landed by the time this bead runs).
- L63 — section header `### Run built-in CA/B Forum TLS BR lints against a chain` → `### Run built-in RFC 5280 lints against a certificate`. Rewrite the code example to use `Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint`.
- L66 — `use pkix_lint::cabf_tls_br::{CabfTlsBrProfile, LintProfile};` → `use pkix_lint::rfc5280::Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint;` + framework usage.
- L115, 117 — deviation example: keep `cabf.br.tls.validity.max` as an illustrative string IF the framework's deviation example clearly shows it as an example of a CABF identifier handled by a downstream crate, OR replace with an RFC-baseline lint id.
- L129, 138 — `EvaluationReport::new("cabf.br.tls", …)` examples: rewrite as `EvaluationReport::new("rfc5280.core", …)` for the framework crate.
- L148, 149 — "Standards" section: narrow to RFC 5280 + adjacent IETF RFCs.

### `pkix-lint-cabf/README.md`

Expand from current 19-LOC stub to a real README:
- Crate-purpose paragraph (reference / not authoritative status).
- The six-lint table (originally in `pkix-lint/README.md` L51–56).
- The usage example (originally in `pkix-lint/README.md` L63–78), updated to import from `pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br`.
- Pointer to `pkix-lint` for the framework + RFC-conformance lints.

### `pkix-lint/src/lib.rs` rustdoc

- L11, L34, L35, L50, L69 — module-level rustdoc with CABF examples: replace with RFC 5280 examples where the framework intent is the focus.
- L606, L612, L651, L671, L675 — `Lint` trait method rustdoc: keep CABF examples where they're illustrating cross-source citation (`<source>-<section>` format intentionally spans RFC and CABF), but ensure the discussion notes that CA/B Forum lint examples live in `pkix-lint-cabf`.
- L817, L969 — `Finding::rule_bundle_version` / `LintRunner::with_bundle_version` rustdoc: replace "pkix-lint/cabf_tls_br v0.2.0" example string with "pkix-lint/rfc5280 v0.5.0" or similar.

### `pkix-lint/src/rfc5280.rs` rustdoc

- L19, L21–22: PKIX-amgn.5.2 already updates these to point at `pkix_lint_cabf`. This bead may need to refine further if the framing of the comment changes substantively.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix-lint/README.md` no longer markets the crate as CABF-shaped.
- [ ] `pkix-lint-cabf/README.md` carries the CABF content (table + usage example).
- [ ] `pkix-lint/src/lib.rs` rustdoc examples reframed (`cabf.br.tls.*` strings retained only where intentionally illustrating cross-source identifier patterns).
- [ ] `cargo doc -p pkix-lint -p pkix-lint-cabf --all-features` clean (no new warnings).

## Out of scope

- `report.rs`, `oscal/emit.rs`, `oscal/parse.rs` illustrative-string scrubbing — those use `"cabf.br.tls"` as opaque profile-id example values; a separate rustdoc tidying pass.
- Version bumps + CHANGELOG (PKIX-amgn.5.5).

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.5.2 (can run in parallel with PKIX-amgn.5.3 once .2 lands).
title: Reframe pkix-lint README + rustdoc post-CABF-move
